name: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Schwarzsee near Kitzbühel is a scenic peat-water tarn at 762 m, known as one of the warmest alpine bathing lakes with boat hires, lido, and Wilder Kaiser reflections.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The breathtaking Schwarzsee near Kitzbühel is situated at an elevation of 762 metres amidst the rolling meadows of the Kitzbühel Alps between Kitzbühel and Reith. Spanning roughly 16 hectares with depths reaching eight metres, this legendary moor tarn is widely recognized as one of the warmest natural bathing lakes in the entire European Alps. Thanks to its rich peat sediment and dark lakebed, surface waters warm rapidly in high summer to blissful temperatures of 24 to 27 degrees Celsius. The mineral-dense moor water boasts renowned restorative qualities for skin and joints, attracting summer vacationers since the 19th century. Photographers revere the lake for its world-famous reflection: during tranquil morning hours, the jagged limestone battlements of the Wilder Kaiser mirror flawlessly upon the still, obsidian water. A modern public lido with manicured sunbathing lawns, swimming piers, and electric boat rentals offers supreme alpine leisure.

Route & Anforderungen

Circling Lake Schwarzsee is a delightful outing suitable for all generations. The level 2.5-kilometre shoreline trail takes roughly 45 to 60 minutes of leisurely walking with virtually no elevation change. The path follows well-tended gravel ways and timber boardwalks skirts reed beds where nesting waterbirds flourish. Strategically placed wooden benches offer scenic pauses facing the alpine panorama. Walkers seeking a longer trek can connect via signposted nature paths to the serene Gieringer Weiher woodland tarn or stroll into downtown Kitzbühel in approximately one hour. The circuit is entirely barrier-free and optimally suited for prams and wheelchairs; casual walking sneakers suffice.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via federal road B170 between Kitzbühel and Kirchberg in Tirol, where paid visitor parking is provided beside the lido. Rail passengers enjoy exceptional convenience, disembarking directly at the dedicated 'Kitzbühel Schwarzsee' train stop situated just two minutes' walk from the water.

Tipps

Rent an electric boat or vintage wooden rowing craft at the lakeshore marina to capture the razor-sharp reflection of the Wilder Kaiser mountains from open water. Afterwards, savor Tyrolean lake trout on the waterside terrace of the lakeside restaurant.
preis: Lakeshore loop freely accessible; municipal beach lido charges summer admission
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeside path open year-round; swimming facilities and boat rentals operate May to September
